steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Switch the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet can be populated.
Add the specified product to the first sheet row.
Confirm the requested product was added.
Verify the product automatically receives the mapped Variant 1 value.
Confirm the quantity remains in the sheet.
Choose the specified delivery location from the dropdown.
Open the product row's Details view.
Verify the details view exposes the product code.
Verify the details view exposes the product variant.
Verify the details view exposes product specifications.
Verify the details view exposes the attachments section.
